To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a 78.8 GHz -92.8 GHz active 4-bit phase shifter with 2.5 dB average gain, 1.68dB RMS gain error, 9.4° RMS phase error, 10.5 dB input return loss and 7 dBm average input referred 0 dB compression point has been designed in 28nm CMOS FDSOI technology.

a 4-bit 78.8 GHz to 92.6 GHz active phase shifter, with an RMS gain error of 1.68dB, an RMS phase error of 9.4°, an input referred 1dB compression point of -8dBm, and a noise figure of 10.8dB, has been implemented in a 28nm FDXOI CMOS technology.
the 4-bit phase shifter is the best performing active phase shifter ever reported for the 78-92 GHz range in terms of gain, phase error, 1 dB compression and noise figure.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a 28nm FSOI CMOS active vector modulator phase shifter for 5G mm-wave applications.
the implementation of a 4-bit (or 16 phase) active vector modulator phase shifter in a 28nm FDXOI CMOS technology for mmWave applications.

the design, implementation, and measurement of a 4-bit (or 16 phase states), 78.8 GHz–92.8GHz, active phase shifter with 0–360o phase coverage, in 28nm fully-depleted silicon-on-insulator (FDSOI) CMOS technology.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the presented active vector modulator phase shifter has demonstrated excellent performances in terms of linearity and noise figure, and a good phase and gain flatness, while exhibiting a very high B3dB, which are all key parameters for the design of high performance millimeter-wave transceivers.
the proposed active phase shifter is the most advanced and performing one in literature, both in terms of frequency range and phase accuracy.
the presented 4-bit phase shifter is the most compact and power efficient phase shifter in the 78–92 GHz range ever reported.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the phase shifter is a key component for the development of high frequency vector modulators, which are the main building blocks for the implementation of phased array antennas for mm-wave applications.
this is the first 28nm FSOI CMOS 4-bit phase shifter with such high frequency coverage, high gain, low noise figure, low RMS gain/phase errors, and good linearity.
we designed and implemented a 4-bit 16 phase state active phase shifter with 2.1-4 dB gain, -10.5-11.5 dB S11, 9.4-11.9° phase error and 10.8-12 dB noise figure.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a phase shifter with 4-bit resolution and 16 states (0–360o) can be implemented in 28 nm FDSOI CM OS technology.
the phase shifter is able to provide a wide bandwidth (14 GHz) and a low phase error (11.9° RMS) at the same time.
the proposed phase shifter is able to achieve a high degree of phase resolution and a wide bandwidth with low gain ripple, high linearity, and low noise figure.
